comment: Append-only supersession index of the R1 rollout evidence artifacts. The contract derives EXECUTION_EVIDENCE (last entry) and PRIOR_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE (second to last) from this chain; appending a new artifact is the only sanctioned way to move the current attestation. Each sha256 freezes the artifact at registration: a dated measurement is never rewritten, a new reading gets a new artifact. Properties enforced by tests/test_smc_r1_evidence_chain.py.
